name: carry_gated
description: Delta-neutral funding carry: long Binance-spot-modelled SPOT + short USDT perp in the same coin and notional, entered when the trailing 7d funding is high and persistent enough to beat the 4-leg round trip, gated by market-wide funding breadth, excluding cap-stressed / 1h-settlement names.
mechanism: Leveraged-long demand from retail plus scarce arbitrage capital keeps perps above spot, so perp shorts are paid funding; the spot leg removes price exposure. Paid for crash/basis/exchange risk (BIS WP1087).
universe: Binance USDT-M perps in the PIT top-30 (daily re-ranked, survivorship-aware), only where a Binance SPOT USDT pair exists (Binance spot first kline = PIT hedgeability proxy); 246 of 263 perps ever in the dev top-30 have a spot pair
timeframe: 1d (decision at the 00:00 UTC close = the 00:07 run; fills next open)

panel.sim_kwargs: carry_gated.sim_kwargs(panel) (per-column slippage; spot = perp tier + 4.5 bps for the 0.10% spot fee)

grid_summary.note: for most coins the cost condition (14*f7 > 1.5*RT, RT 0.35-0.63%) binds before h: it implies ~17-25%/yr, so h in {8,12,15}% changes little

frozen_rule: most-chosen config across the walk-forward folds; ties broken by the best median train-rank across folds

null.kind: pair_random_timing (both legs moved together, per-coin run lengths kept, placed inside the coin's hedgeable+top30 span; FROZEN, OOS span 2022-01..2025-06)

implementability_200.note: Bybit spot rules from public instruments-info (basePrecision/minOrderQty/minOrderAmt), converted to perp price units; instruments are TODAY's, applied to history.
implementability_200.dropped_orders_note: First-pass count (450/796 = 57%) was WRONG: it counted the 1e-9 re-issue jitter as the order size. Recount on executed qty changes of the unrounded run: 24 of 796 orders (3.0%) are below Bybit minimums.
implementability_200.verdict_200: FROZEN as-is is NOT implementable on $200: legs are $25 (K=8) and the Bybit perp qtyStep of BTC (0.001), ETH (0.01), SOL/LTC (0.1) is worth more than a leg, so rounding leaves spot unhedged. OOS Sharpe 4.78 -> 0.55, DD -0.5% -> -7.1%, CAGR 4.8% -> 2.8%. Fix = account_usd=200 filter (skip coins whose perp step > 10% of a leg; causal on price).

account_usd_200_variant.note: not searched (a feasibility filter, fixed at 10%)

vol_target_variant.params: fold-chosen params + vol_target=0.20, lev_cap=2.5 per leg (gross 5x), L changed only on >25% moves, borrow 8% APR on spot notional above 1x equity

liquidation_checks.note: Close marks (default): no liquidation. OOS (2022+): none under body or raw marks either. But in the dev run the 2.5x book is liquidated on 2020-03-12 under body AND raw marks. The lab check is pessimistic for a hedge, but the basis did blow out that day and Bybit UTA haircuts spot collateral, so the 2.5x variant is NOT shown to be liquidation-safe.

vol_target_variant.feasibility: 20% vol is unreachable: natural vol ~1-2%, the cap binds (2.5x per leg = gross 5x) and realised OOS vol is 2.4%. Borrow (8% APR on spot above 1x) costs ~2.7 pts of CAGR (11.5% borrow-free -> 8.8%).

natural_vol_note: The main stream (wf, oos_daily, frozen_dev_daily) is the NATURAL 1x book (vol_target=None): spot notional <= 1x equity, realised vol ~2%/yr. vol_target_variant is the 20%-target request, capped at 2.5x per leg.
expectancy_per_trade_units: USD per pair round trip on the $200-start OOS book
funding_sign_note: negative funding_per_year = funding RECEIVED (lab convention + = paid)

live_targets_example_last_dev_bar.orders: market BUY spot + market SELL perp (same notional) for new pairs, reverse for dropped pairs, at the 00:07 run; perp stopLoss far (e.g. 3x the liquidation clearance rule allows) - it is a hedge leg

drift_control_ablation.note: Without re-sizing, qty is held while prices move: a 5x alt rally in 2021 = 5x hidden notional/equity (27% 'CAGR' in the first pass). With 25% drift re-sizing: max gross 2.4.

caveats: Small, regime-dependent return. Walk-forward OOS 2022-01..2025-06: CAGR 4.6%, Sharpe 4.47, maxDD -0.5%, realised vol 1.0%. By year: 2022 -0.1%, 2023 +3.4%, 2024 +12.5%, 2025H1 +0.7%. Dev-period CAGR 15.4% comes only from 2020-21 (+25%/+48%).

Mostly idle now. Days with any pair: 2022 8%. The last dev bar (2025-06-29) holds 0 pairs. Phase 1 found the clean opportunity set empty in 2025-26 (Ethena ~4%). Expect ~0-5%/yr at 1x in the current regime.
Activity: ~0.028 pair entries/day (~1 a month), 0.27 leg orders/day incl. drift re-sizing. It does NOT deliver daily activity.

Sharpe > 2 is expected for carry, and I hunted for a bug. Funding per trade matches the raw settlement sum. Price P&L over 5.5y is ~0 (daily spot-perp hedge error std 0.13%). Funding is booked only after the next-open fill. Costs are 4 legs incl. the 0.10% spot fee. The high Sharpe comes from ~1% vol. The real price of this return is crash, exchange, ADL and one-legged-fill risk, which the sample does not contain (BIS WP1087).

Funding and spot data are BINANCE, but the bot trades BYBIT. Alt funding differs by venue. Coins without a Binance spot pair (HYPE, FARTCOIN, MOODENG...) are excluded, though Bybit lists some. The Binance spot first-kline date is the proxy for PIT hedgeability.

Lab liquidation check: it puts each leg at its own extreme (long at low, short at high), which cannot represent a same-coin hedge. The default panel therefore uses close marks, so intrabar basis spikes are not modelled. At 1x, raw and body marks also give 0 liquidations (with drift control). The 2.5x vol-target variant is liquidated on 2020-03-12 under raw/body marks.

Drift control is essential. The sim holds qty between weight changes. Without re-sizing, the 2021 alt rallies ran the book at up to 6x gross (first pass: 27% CAGR plus a liquidation). With 25%-band re-sizing: 15.4% dev / 4.6% OOS.

$200: FROZEN as-is fails. Coarse perp qtySteps (BTC/ETH/SOL/LTC) leave legs unmatched, and the rounded OOS Sharpe is 0.55. The account_usd=200 filter fixes it (rounded OOS CAGR 4.8%, Sharpe 4.86, DD -0.4%). Instruments are TODAY's; 16 traded spot names and 11 perps are no longer on Bybit.

The market gate (>60% of top-30 perps with f7>0) was NOT selected: FROZEN has gate=None. It barely binds (on ~100% of days in most years); with it the OOS Sharpe goes 4.78 -> 5.20. What binds is the cost filter (14d funding > 1.5x the 0.35-0.63% round trip), so h in {8,12,15}% changes little.

WF picks were split: 3 folds chose (h=20%, K=8, gate 0.6), 3 chose (h=8%, K=8, no gate), 1 chose K=5. FROZEN won the tie-break on median train rank. Neighbours give OOS Sharpe 4.0-5.2 and CAGR 4.5-5.2%, so it is stable. PBO 0.11. DSR ~1.0 (it does not see tail risk). Pair-level random-timing null: 96th percentile, p=0.045, null mean Sharpe 3.2. The timing rule adds only modestly; most of the value is simply being in carry.

Vol-target 20% is infeasible. Capped at 2.5x per leg (gross 5x) it reaches 2.4% realised vol, OOS CAGR 8.8% after 8% borrow (11.5% borrow-free), and it is not liquidation-safe on 2020-03-12 under conservative marks. Bybit UTA spot-collateral haircuts (<1 for alts) are not modelled.
Top-3 coins = 47% of OOS P&L (PEPE, CFX, DOGE), just under the phase-1 50% limit.
lab_notes: sim liquidation check values each column at its own adverse extreme independently. That false-liquidates same-asset hedges (2021-05-19 with drifted leverage). Workaround: the hedge_marks='close' panel.
nulls.random_timing_null / sign_flip_null permute each column independently, which un-hedges a 2-leg book and makes the null meaningless. I used a custom pair-level null.
run_weights(round_to_qty=True) does not report dropped orders; I counted them separately.
on_change lets hedged notional drift without limit (by design); a multi-leg strategy must re-issue its targets.
There is one global fee, so the spot 0.10% fee is modelled as +4.5 bps per-column slippage.
